hypothesis: capability on the 50-item copilot eval is non-monotonic across copilot-3b-lora v1..v3c (some checkpoint regresses vs its predecessor on at least one reference-check type)

kill_switch.note: at least one checkpoint regresses: extend to per-check-type attribution + McNemar
monotonic or flat across all five: the lineage is clean, report as replication

tension: Five checkpoints of the same lineage were trained sequentially, and nobody has measured whether capability rose monotonically. If any checkpoint regresses vs its predecessor, every claim built on the final checkpoint inherits an unchecked dip. A lineage its own authors cannot characterize is not a foundation.
